title: WEBSITE & AI VISIBILITY GROWTH PLANS
h1: Your website needs to do more than just exist.
tagline: Be found. Build trust. Generate enquiries. Get noticed by AI.
intro: Your website is often the first impression a potential customer has of your business. But is it actually helping you win more customers?
The way people search for businesses is changing. Traditional Google searches are now sharing the stage with AI-powered platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
Your website needs to work for both.
Ad On Digital combines professional website design, ongoing website care, search optimisation and AI-focused content strategies to help your business build a stronger online presence.
Whether you need a professional website or want to improve your visibility across search engines and AI platforms, we have a package to help.

problem.h: Is your website working hard enough for your business?
problem.lead: You might recognise some of these problems:
items: Your website looks old, outdated or unprofessional.
You're not getting enough enquiries through your website.
Your competitors appear ahead of you in Google searches.
Your business isn't being mentioned or recommended by AI platforms.
You're unsure whether your website is structured for the changing world of online search.
Your website content hasn't been updated in months or years.
You're not generating enough genuine online reviews.
You know your online presence needs attention, but don't have the time or expertise to manage it.
close: The problem isn't necessarily that you don't have a website.
It's that your website may not be working hard enough for your business.
And as the way people search continues to change, businesses that don't adapt risk being left behind.

better.h: A better way to manage your online presence

Our Website & AI Visibility Growth Plans bring together three important elements.

pillars.title: Get discovered
text: We build strong website foundations and help improve your visibility through traditional search engine optimisation (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO).
The goal is to make your business easier for search engines and AI platforms to understand, interpret and discover.

Our monthly plans provide ongoing website care, content improvements and, in our Premium Growth package, additional AEO and AI visibility activities designed to help your business adapt as online search evolves.

faqs.q: What is AEO and how is it different from SEO?
a: SEO stands for Search Engine Optimisation. It involves improving your website so that it can be better understood and ranked by traditional search engines such as Google.

AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimisation. It focuses on structuring and improving your website content so that AI-powered platforms and answer engines can better understand your business and the information you provide.
Both are important as the way people search for information, products and services continues to evolve.

faqs.q: Why does my business need AEO?
a: People are increasingly using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to ask questions, research services and compare businesses.
AEO helps make your website content clearer, more structured and easier for these platforms to interpret.
It is not a guarantee that an AI platform will mention or recommend your business, but it helps establish a stronger foundation for AI discovery.

faqs.q: Will my business appear in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini?
a: No agency can guarantee that an AI platform will mention, recommend or refer customers to your business.
These platforms use their own systems and processes to select and present information.
Our services are designed to improve your website's structure, content and online information so that your business has a stronger foundation for discovery.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Starter and Premium Growth?
a: Starter provides a professionally designed and maintained website, with basic SEO and AEO-friendly foundations.

Premium Growth includes everything in Starter, plus ongoing AEO and AI search optimisation, one monthly blog article, review management software, structured data, online authority activities and AI visibility monitoring.
Starter includes up to 10 website pages.
Premium Growth includes up to 20 website pages.
Additional pages or significant changes to the agreed website scope may incur additional charges, which will be discussed and approved before work begins.

faqs.q: Can I make changes to my website?
a: Yes. Both packages include up to one hour of routine website changes per month.
This may include updating text, replacing images or making minor adjustments to existing pages.
Unused monthly change time does not roll over. Larger changes, new functionality, additional pages or redesign work may be quoted separately.

faqs.q: Does Premium Growth include new blog articles?
a: Yes. Premium Growth includes one AI-optimised blog article per month.
The content will be developed around relevant topics and questions that may be useful to your potential customers and your online visibility.
Unused monthly blog articles do not roll over.

faqs.q: How does Ad On Review Management Software work?
a: The software helps you request genuine reviews from your customers and receive notifications when new reviews are submitted.
You provide Ad On Digital with the relevant customer contact details, and review requests can be sent by SMS or email within your monthly allowance.
Your allowance is 100 SMS sends and 1,000 email sends per month.

faqs.q: Does Ad On Digital respond to negative reviews or customer complaints?
a: No. Ad On Digital provides the review management software and notifications only.
If a customer leaves a negative review or raises a complaint, you are responsible for contacting that customer, responding to their concerns and resolving the matter directly.
We do not manage customer complaints or respond to negative reviews on your behalf.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee Google rankings or AI recommendations?
a: No. Search engine rankings and AI-generated responses are controlled by independent third-party platforms and can change without notice.
We cannot guarantee specific rankings, website traffic, leads, sales, AI mentions or recommendations.
Our services focus on improving your website, content and online foundations to support better visibility.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum contract period?
a: Yes. Both packages have an initial six-month minimum commitment.
After the initial six-month period, the subscription continues on a month-to-month basis unless cancelled in accordance with the Terms & Conditions.

faqs.q: What happens after the initial six months?
a: After the initial six-month commitment, your subscription continues month-to-month.
You can continue with your package at the applicable monthly price or provide 30 days' written notice to cancel.
Existing Ad On Group customers retain their discounted monthly pricing for as long as their subscription remains active.

faqs.q: Can I purchase ownership of my website?
a: Yes. After completing your initial six-month minimum commitment, you have the option to purchase ownership of your eligible website design and original content for a one-off fee of $2,500 + GST.
This is entirely optional. If you choose to continue with your monthly subscription, your website and included services remain covered under your selected package.

faqs.q: What happens to my monthly services if I purchase my website?
a: Purchasing your website transfers ownership of the eligible website design and original content to you. However, your monthly subscription services will come to an end unless separately agreed.

This means ongoing AEO and SEO optimisation, monthly blogs, Ad On Review Management Software, review notifications, AI visibility monitoring, hosting, maintenance and monthly website changes will no longer be included.
You would be responsible for arranging these services independently.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay extra for hosting or website maintenance?
a: No. Hosting, security and routine website maintenance are included in both monthly packages while your subscription remains active.

faqs.q: Who do I contact if I need help?
a: You'll have access to the Ad On Digital team for support with your website and included services. We believe in providing personal service and making it easy for customers to speak with someone when they need assistance.
